1. Plants (Subject) perform (Predicate) photosynthesis (Object).
2. Photosynthesis (Subject) occurs (Predicate) in chloroplasts (Object).
3. Chloroplasts (Subject) contain (Predicate) chlorophyll (Object).
4. Chlorophyll (Subject) absorbs (Predicate) sunlight (Object).
5. Sunlight (Subject) provides (Predicate) energy (Object).
6. Photosynthesis (Subject) produces (Predicate) glucose and oxygen (Object).
7. Glucose (Subject) serves (Predicate) as energy storage (Object).
8. Oxygen (Subject) is released (Predicate) as a byproduct (Object).
9. Carbon dioxide (Subject) is used (Predicate) in photosynthesis (Object).
10. Water (Subject) is absorbed (Predicate) by plants (Object).
11. Light energy (Subject) drives (Predicate) chemical reactions (Object).
12. Stroma (Subject) contains (Predicate) enzymes (Object).
13. Thylakoid membranes (Subject) house (Predicate) photosynthetic pigments (Object).
14. Photosystem II (Subject) initiates (Predicate) electron transport chain (Object).
15. ATP synthase (Subject) produces (Predicate) ATP molecules (Object).
16. The Calvin cycle (Subject) fixes (Predicate) carbon dioxide (Object).
17. Enzyme RuBisCO (Subject) facilitates (Predicate) carbon fixation (Object).
18. Photosynthesis (Subject) consists (Predicate) of light-dependent reactions and the Calvin cycle (Object).
19. ATP and NADPH (Subject) power (Predicate) the Calvin cycle (Object).
20. Photosynthesis (Subject) supports (Predicate) the food chain (Object).
